value.hook: When reviewing in an isolated archive or testing with an out-of-tree Cargo manifest
value.title: Shared-build must run from the manifest source tree

sections.name: body
sections.value: shared-build derives its artifact-owner stamp and crate-root touch set from the current Git worktree, or cwd outside Git (harness/scripts/shared-build.sh). --manifest-path does not change that owner. Running from the review checkout against a separate archived source tree let another branch replace core artifacts between mutant runs; the next mutant failed to compile against a foreign Queue trait. That compile failure was not counted as killed. Run just shared-build from the actual source directory, with the same resolved shared target. The corrected #311 replay killed all six intended guard mutants and restored a 16/16 baseline. Always restore source bytes and refresh mtime, and distinguish assertion failures from invalid compilation.
